EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tonight's the yearly Countdown
celebration!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} You'd be straight silly
to miss this event!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hoy se celebra la cuenta atrás
de fin de año.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Acércate esta noche
a celebrarlo en la plaza del pueblo.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ce soir, c'est le grand compte à
rebours !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu seras sur la place de la
ville toi aussi ?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bu gece yıllık Geri Sayım
şenliği var!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bunu kaçırmak düpedüz
saçmalık olur!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I think in some ways, the Countdown
celebration is the one event of the
year that gets me the most excited.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Can't you see? I'm already trembling
with excitement!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si lo piensas,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} la cuenta atrás es
la celebración más intensa del año.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¡Se concentra en pocos segundos!
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}¿Ves?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Ya me ha entrado el
tembleque!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je crois que le compte à rebours,
c'est l'événement de l'année qui me
fait le plus d'effet...{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}C'est simple, je tiens plus en place !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il conto alla rovescia è troppo forte!
{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Guarda... Tremo già dall'emozione!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Von allen Festen und Ereignissen
gehört der {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Countdown {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}zu denen,
die ich am ehesten mag.
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Siehst du?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich zittere schon vor
Aufregung!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bence bir bakıma Geri Sayım şenliği,
yıl içinde beni en çok heyecanlandıran
etkinlik.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Görmüyor musun? Heyecandan şimdiden titriyorum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Of course the summer fireworks are
nice too, but{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} you can't forget how
nice the midnight fireworks are!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}I'm really looking forward to this
year's Countdown!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Los fuegos artificiales de verano
están muy bien,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} ¡pero como los
de Nochevieja...!
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}¡Ya estoy deseando que empiece
la cuenta atrás!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je vais pas dénigrer les feux
d'artifice d'été, hein... Mais ceux de
la fin d'année, c'est autre chose.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}J'ai hâte d'être au compte à
rebours,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} je suis excité comme une
puce !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I fuochi d'artificio estivi non sono
male,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} ma i fuochi di mezzanotte
sono tutta un'altra storia!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Dai, vediamoci più tardi
per il {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}conto alla rovescia{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Klar, Feuerwerk ist immer toll,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
aber der {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Countdown {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}ist dann doch
was Besonderes!
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Ich bin schon gespannt!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Are you going to participate in the
countdown tonight too?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} It's the
end of {{TAG:0004:0000:}}! It's finally here!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu vas sortir pour le compte à
rebours cette nuit ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}L'année {{TAG:0004:0000:}} touche à sa fin !
Faut fêter ça, non ?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sen de bu geceki geri sayıma
katılacak mısın?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0004:0000:}} yılının
sonu! Sonunda geldi!
